ModeValue.note: Ported from SessionModeControl — two AnimatedSwapText values (model name, mode label + detail) as ComposerControlButton labels on a composer-background bar. Swap text is the emphasized white label against the muted detail, exactly the two-tone hierarchy the component exists for.

CyclingValue.note: Stateful wrapper keyed on valueKey; renders the committed value ('Build · auto-approve edits') with a secondary Button that drives the swap. Both the control and the trigger render whole.

InlineMeta.note: Non-composer usage: text-chat-meta row with the swapped model name in text-foreground against muted surrounding meta. Varies the axis (inline meta vs pill control) and stays legible.
